items.body:
### Godot version

4.0-beta 2

### System information

Windows 11, Vulkan, RTX 3070 V. 516.94

### Issue description

I want to create a globally accessible lookup table for scenes but :

I cannot preload scenes that reference the scene that is attempting to preload them. 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47256718/193256289-be26768d-c267-4618-a83c-d87121297d2f.png)


```gdscript
# autoload.gd
var any_scene = preload("res://scene.tscn")


# scene.tscn
static func get_scene():  # does not need to be static to fail
    return Globals.any_scene
```

When using load inside _ready of the instead of preload using the loaded scene within the autoload causes cyclic dependency to be thrown.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47256718/193256938-4fe2db61-52f7-4be8-8117-edc7bc9e3d21.png)

```gdscript

#autoload.gd
var any_scene
func _ready():
    any_scene = load("res://scene.tscn")
    AnyScript.get_any() # fails with cyclic
    
# scene.tscn
class_name AnyScript extends Node # to access static members


static func get_any():
    return Globals.any_scene # get autoload scene

```

Don't know if that is intentional.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an Autoload/Singelton
2. Create a Scene that references the autoload in its script
3. preload the scene within the autoload

### Minimal reproduction project

[CyclicTest.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9683605/CyclicTest.zip)
